card.name: Punctuation opening section cross-references
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or comma right after a section title in a label cross-reference, such as 'see Contraindications (' or 'Clinical Studies ('. It also fires on the comma between section numbers in a list.

modes.label: Parenthesis after section name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis follows a named label section inside a bracketed 'see' reference, just before the section number.

modes.label: Comma between section numbers
modes.description: A comma separates section numbers inside a parenthetical cross-reference.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where a section name is about to be followed by its section number.
